'''Avel·lí Corma i Canós''' {{Postnom|country=GBR|ForMemRS}} (born December 15, 1951; name in [[Valencian language|Catalan-Valencian]], also ''Avelino'' in [[Spanish language|Spanish]]) is a [[Spaniards|Spanish]] [[chemist]] distinguished for his world-leading work on [[heterogeneous catalysis]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=2023-07-04 |title=Avel·lí Corma rep aquest dimarts el Premi a l'Inventor Europeu a tota la trajectòria professional |language=Catalan |work=[[À Punt]] |url=https://www.apuntmedia.es/noticies/societat/avel-li-corma-rep-aquest-dimarts-premi-l-inventor-europeu-tota-trajectoria-professional_1_1628671.html |access-date=2023-07-04}}</ref>

He received a [[Bachelor of Science]] in [[chemistry]] from the [[University of Valencia|University of València]] (1967-1973) and a [[Ph.D.]] in chemistry from the [[Universidad Complutense de Madrid]] in 1976. In 1979 he started working as a researcher at the [[Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas]], and in 1987 he was a full professor. He has been carrying out research in [[heterogeneous catalysis]] in academia and in collaboration with companies. He has worked on fundamental aspects of acid-base and redox catalysis with the aim of understanding the nature of the active sites and reaction mechanisms. Based on these aspects, he has developed catalysts that are being used commercially in several industrial processes.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Corma, el químico español de las 100 patentes|url=http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20140528/avelino-corma-quimico-espanol-100-patentes/944222.shtml|website=RTVE.es|date=28 May 2014 |publisher=RTVE|accessdate=29 October 2014}}</ref>

He has published more than 1200 documents<ref>[https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.url?authorId=7202318774 "Avelino Corma publication profile"]</ref> and has more than 200 patents.<ref name=":0" /> Over 20 of those patents have been applied industrially in commercial processes of cracking, desulfuration, isomerization, epoxidation, chemo selective oxidation of alcohols and chemoselective hydrogenations.

Corma Canós was elected a member of the [[National Academy of Engineering]] (USA) in 2007 for contributions to the understanding of heterogeneous catalysis that led to numerous commercialized solid catalysts used worldwide.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2021-01-21 |title=Avel·lí Corma, investigador distingit |language=ca |work=[[Universitat de València]] |url=https://www.upv.es/noticias-upv/noticia-13377-avelino-corma-va.html |access-date=2023-07-04}}</ref>

In a 2022 ''[[ACS Catalysis]]'' paper, Corma Canós was described as "one of the most influential scientists in the field of heterogeneous catalysis and materials science".<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Boronat |first1=Mercedes |last2=Climent |first2=Maria J. |last3=Concepción |first3=Patricia |last4=Díaz |first4=Urbano |last5=García |first5=Hermenegildo |last6=Iborra |first6=Sara |last7=Leyva-Pérez |first7=Antonio |last8=Liu |first8=Lichen |last9=Martínez |first9=Agustin |last10=Martínez |first10=Cristina |last11=Moliner |first11=Manuel |last12=Pérez-Pariente |first12=Joaquín |last13=Rey |first13=Fernando |last14=Sastre |first14=Enrique |last15=Serna |first15=Pedro |date=2022-06-17 |title=A Career in Catalysis: Avelino Corma |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acscatal.2c01043 |journal=ACS Catalysis |language=en |volume=12 |issue=12 |pages=7054–7123 |doi=10.1021/acscatal.2c01043 |s2cid=249294058 |issn=2155-5435|url-access=subscription }}</ref> A special issue in [[Chemistry (MDPI journal)|''Chemistry'']], an [[MDPI]] journal, was published in his honor.<ref>{{Cite journal |title=Heterogeneous Catalysis — a Theme Issue in Honor of Prof. Dr. Avelino Corma |url=https://www.mdpi.com/journal/chemistry/special_issues/F105X7V310 |journal=[[Chemistry (MDPI journal)|Chemistry]] |issn=2624-8549}}</ref>
